scope: Original-disc native initialization/mount followed by case-insensitive backend open, three unaligned offsets and three sequential read patterns including zero request, oversized EOF clamp, read past EOF, repeated reopen and close of E_00B7.MLT. Full retail RAM/CPU/FPU/SR/PR/MACL/event/MMIO equality; independently checked mounted records, file handle/LBA/size, exact disc sector bytes, read position, close flag and BIOS request. BIOS delivery/scheduling/version bytes, cache and driver-enable modeled; audio bank download not exercised.
